headline: T. Rowe Price Group (TROW) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift As Analysts Rework Models
summary: The updated fair value estimate for T. Rowe Price Group has moved from US$97.42 to US$110.00, signaling a higher price target in the latest model refresh. This shift is landing in the middle of recent Street targets that cluster just above US$100 and run up to about US$121, where analysts are weighing solid execution against questions on how much upside is already in the stock. In the sections that follow, you will see how this evolving narrative fits into your own view of T. Rowe Price Group...
